meta.title: dsh-plugin-workspace-browser
meta.description: Open an isolated Chromium window for a DSH workspace.

sessionWorkspaceMissing: This session is not in a registered workspace.
browserGenerationChanged: The Chromium instance changed during the request.
dockerCliMissing: Docker was not found. Install Docker or check the configured executable.
dockerCliUnavailable: The Docker CLI could not run. Check the configured executable and its permissions.
dockerEndpointUnsupported: Use the default local Docker endpoint. Remote engines cannot mount this workspace.
dockerIdentityUnsupported: On Linux, run DSH as a non-root user and use a rootful Docker engine without user namespace remapping. On Windows or macOS, use local Docker Desktop.
runnerWorkspaceInvalid: Check that the registered workspace still names its original directory and that Docker can share it with read/write access.
dockerEngineUnavailable: Could not reach the local Docker engine. Make sure Docker is running.
dockerEngineIncompatible: The workspace browser requires a local Linux/amd64 Docker engine.
runnerImageMissing: The Chromium runner image is missing. Build it in the plugin’s Environment settings.
runnerImageIncompatible: The Chromium runner image is incompatible. Rebuild it in the plugin’s Environment settings.
runnerBuildInputsMissing: The Chromium runner build files are missing or unreadable. Reinstall the complete plugin bundle.
runnerBuildFailed: Docker could not build the Chromium runner image.
runnerBuildTimeout: Building the Chromium runner image timed out.
runnerBuildImageInvalid: The built Chromium runner image did not pass validation.
environmentBuildHelp: Docker builds the Chromium runner image locally. It may download a base image and packages, and can take several minutes.
environmentBuildStatusError: Could not get the runner image build status.
environmentBuildRequestError: Could not request a runner image build.
runnerBundleInvalid: The Chromium image is missing or damaged.
runnerImageLoadFailed: Could not import the Chromium image.
runnerProfileInUse: Another container is using this browser profile.
runnerProfileRecoveryFailed: Could not clear stale Chromium profile locks.
runnerDisplayFailed: The Chromium display could not start.
localDshRequired: This DSH origin is not allowed to access the workspace browser.
handshakeFailed: The browser display could not connect.
handshakeTimeout: The browser display did not connect in time.
requestFailed: The browser service could not complete the request.
sessionAgentAccess: Allow agent browser access for this session
originDescription: Enter one trusted HTTP(S) origin per line, for example https://dsh.example.com. Include any non-default port, but no path or wildcard. Leave empty for local access only. Saving restarts the plugin and may interrupt active browser sessions. Removing the origin you are using may prevent you from accessing the workspace browser here.
idleDescription: Stop Chromium after the last workspace view has been disconnected for this long. Changes apply without restarting Chromium. Set to 0 to keep it running indefinitely.
idleInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1440.
agentSettingsLabel: Allow agents to use the workspace browser
agentSettingsDescription: Applies to the current DSH profile. Each session still needs its own authorization. Turning this off revokes existing authorizations without interrupting manual browsing.
